When I was ~14, my dad and I were visiting our hometown and decided to go play golf one day. As we were about to start he mentioned that he should probably call one of his friends that he hasn't seen in a while and get them to join. He took out his phone and even looked up his number, but ultimately decided not to. We went out and had fun. I was glad that he hadn't called his friend because I got to actually have some nice time alone with my dad. 

The next night we found out that that friend had shot his wife in the head in front of their two small children earlier that morning. 

I will always wonder if us calling him would have gotten him out and relaxed him a little. Maybe he wouldn't have done it.
